newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Boeing Co raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Boeing Co raised.

text.p: -- BT Securities said it upgraded Boeing Co to strong buy from buy.

-- said Boeing first quarter results were below expectations due to challenges the company faced as it doubles its annual production, integrates an acquisition, negotiates with regulators on the McDonnell Douglas Corp merger, develops a new fighter and manages the international space station development.
-- said the first quarter also showed higher-than-expected research and development spending.
-- said near-term earnings prospects are a "little less than we had previously projected."
-- said expects Boeing to earn $4.75 a share in 1997 and $6.65 a share in 1998. Previous estimates were not immediately available.
-- said the longer-term 1999-2000 earnings per share estimates in the $9-$11 range remain unchanged.
-- said "the quarter's performance, despite the margin pressures, represents excellent news, in view of Boeing's reiterated forecast for 340 jetliner deliveries this year."
-- said the decline in Boeing's share price after its first quarter earnings report represents "a buying opportunity of some value."
